title: Vampire
body:
The Vampire is an enemy added in the Halloween 2024 update. The Vampire can appear during a Blood Moon, which last 5 in-game hours or 5 minutes in real life. When killed, it drops 1-3 Bone, 1-3 Candycorn, and a Meat Vinyl Player.

It can spawn in the center of the Farlands (near the Lighthouse), the Taiga (behind Alan's Autologistics) and in the Savannah.
